scripts.build: node -e "if (parseInt(process.versions.node) < 20) { console.log('Node.js v20+ required for Vite build. Skipping since current version is ' + process.version); process.exit(0); } else { process.exit(1); }" || npm --prefix react-build run build
scripts.test: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('.tmp/ts-tests', { recursive: true, force: true })" && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --noCheck && node --test .tmp/ts-tests/src/agents/**/*.test.js .tmp/ts-tests/src/retrieval/**/*.test.js .tmp/ts-tests/src/ai/**/*.test.js && node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('.tmp/ts-tests', { recursive: true, force: true })"
scripts.coverage: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('.tmp/ts-tests', { recursive: true, force: true })" && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --noCheck && node --experimental-test-coverage --test .tmp/ts-tests/src/agents/**/*.test.js .tmp/ts-tests/src/retrieval/**/*.test.js .tmp/ts-tests/src/ai/**/*.test.js && node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('.tmp/ts-tests', { recursive: true, force: true })"
